messages.subject: SCANS reference request?
parts:
Dear all,

a general request - I am looking for a paper which was published
concerning the results of the SCANS survey. I don't have a title for
it but it details the methods and analysis of the distance-sampling
data for the estimation of cetacean abundances in the North Sea. I
believe one of the authors was D. Borchers and the paper was in
Biometrics (possibly) and was published late last year/early 2000?

If anyone has any idea of the paper I'm talking about, it would be
much appreciated if they could give me a complete reference or if
possible, send me a photocopy of it.

Apologies for such a general request but I have searched
journals/authors on the net and could not locate it.

Many thanks
Kelly
